_comment: Golden snapshot for case I18N-03a: every CJK string literal that scripts/lit_api.py and scripts/cite_integrity.py contained BEFORE the message tables were introduced (commit b0db1e0; scanner = evals/test_regression.py:_stray_cjk_literals, i.e. appendix A of the English-mode design). Each fragment, split at %s/%d, must still occur verbatim in the zh side of MESSAGES. Static file, not something make_fixtures.py can regenerate: the inventory is updated only when a zh string is changed on purpose, in the same commit as that change, never to make a case pass (so far: the two citation-age flags quality.zero_cites and quality.low_cites, reworded to say calendar years).
